## Summary

**Case CASE-014 — classified as `bank_fee`**

**What I found**
- `BNK-0125`: bank-only outflow of **USD 45.00** on **2026-08-31**, description "MONTHLY ACCOUNT SERVICE CHARGE", channel `bank_charge`, no invoice/bill reference, no matched ledger entry.
- `DOC-007` (bank's Business Checking Fee Schedule, effective 2026-01-01): monthly account service charge of **USD 45.00, debited on the last business day of the month** — matching the amount and date exactly. The schedule also notes fees are debited as separate statement line items.

**Why this classification**
The bank levied the charge directly against the account and it was never booked. It isn't a timing difference (it cleared the bank but was never in the ledger), isn't tied to any reference or counterparty transaction, and there is no second recording of it anywhere.

**Proposed fix** (pending human approval — nothing has been posted)
- Debit `6100 Bank Fees` 45.00
- Credit `1000 Cash - Operating` 45.00

This records the expense and reduces ledger cash by 45.00, bringing the book balance in line with the bank statement.

No material uncertainty here — the fee schedule corroborates the amount and timing precisely.
